data.desc: Callan JMB Inc. (NASDAQ: CJMB) is a diversified logistics, preparedness, and critical-infrastructure company supporting healthcare organizations, government agencies, and commercial partners. The Company provides fulfillment, warehousing, cold-chain logistics, monitoring, regulatory compliance, and emergency-preparedness services designed to protect critical products, strengthen supply chains, and support continuity of operations. Through its portfolio of businesses, strategic partnerships, and acquisitions, Callan JMB is expanding its capabilities across healthcare and pharmaceutical logistics, domestic manufacturing, critical-infrastructure services, energy development, and the planned domestic manufacturing of transformers and other critical electrical equipment to support grid reliability and energy resilience.
